title: Unauthenticated API Access on Admin Endpoint
description: The /api/admin/users endpoint allows access without a valid authentication token. Any user can view PII of all registered users.
stepsToReproduce: Observe JSON response containing user PII
businessImpact: Compromise of user data, potential regulatory fines.
remediation: Implement token validation middleware on all /api/admin routes.

title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Dashboard Search
description: The search parameter on the dashboard is reflected in the DOM without sanitization, allowing arbitrary script execution.
businessImpact: Session hijacking, unauthorized actions on behalf of the user.
remediation: Use context-aware output encoding or a safe UI framework like React without dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
